evidence.note: Front-loads a Task ledger via TaskCreate covering all major feature families, but bundles ~150 functions into one task and most endpoints/analyst features into a single giant task — coarse granularity.
Sustained TaskUpdate in_progress→completed transitions as each area is built and tested; the ledger is kept live across the whole build arc rather than abandoned.
Adds new verification-specific tasks (persistence-across-restart, perf) — extends tracking in response to what still needs checking.
TaskList mid-stream to reconcile the current state before wrapping up — self-report reconciliation, though not tied cell-by-cell to hidden-suite coverage.
Perf bench iteration: detects a performance problem, edits recompute logic, reruns — shows noticing a stuck subsystem and adjusting rather than looping.

reasoning: The agent maintains a genuine, continuously-updated task ledger of major feature families across the entire horizon and reconciles it with a mid-stream TaskList review, exceeding anchor 5 (checklist of major features). It also creates verification tasks and shows one clear instance of detecting and correcting a perf stall. However, tracking is coarse — the ~150-function catalog and most endpoints are collapsed into single bundled tasks, with no per-function/per-endpoint done/partial/not-started granularity and no evidence of systematically catching dropped sub-items — so it falls short of anchor 8's live granular ledger. This places it at 6.
